teaser.en: 'Stomach of the pig': a bush legume whose twisting stems reminded someone of a pig's coiled insides.
teaser.sw: 'Tumbo la nguruwe': mmea wa jamii ya kunde wa vichakani ambao mashina yake yanayojisokota yalimkumbusha mtu matumbo ya nguruwe yaliyojiviringa.
teaser.dg: 'Humbo ra nguluwe': chitsaka cha jamii ya kunde, ambacho mihiye inayobeta yamtambukiza mutu mahumbo ga nguluwe ganayodzizunguluka.

summary.en: Humbo ra nguluwe is a shrubby legume of the coastal bush with yellow pea-flowers and jointed pods. Its name, 'the pig's stomach', describes how its stems twist.
summary.sw: Humbo ra nguluwe ni kichaka cha jamii ya kunde kinachoota vichakani pwani, chenye maua ya manjano ya umbo la ua la njegere na maganda yenye viungo. Jina lake, 'tumbo la nguruwe', linaeleza jinsi mashina yake yanavyojisokota.
summary.dg: *Humbo ra nguluwe* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kunde cha weruni wa pwani, chenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde na makakaya genye mafundo. Dzinare, 'humbo ra nguluwe', rinaonyesa vira mihiye inavyobeta.

about.en: Humbo ra nguluwe is a shrub, sometimes small and tree-like, of the pea family. Its leaves are pinnate, with many small rounded leaflets along a central stalk. The flowers are yellow pea-flowers, often streaked with red. Like other *Ormocarpum*, the pods are jointed, breaking into one-seeded segments that are often warty or bristly. Pakia's explanation of the name points to the stems, which twist and wind.
about.sw: Humbo ra nguluwe ni kichaka, wakati mwingine mti mdogo, wa familia ya kunde. Majani yake ni ya mchanganyiko, yenye vijani vingi vidogo vya mviringo kando ya kikonyo cha kati. Maua ni ya manjano, ya umbo la ua la njegere, mara nyingi yenye michirizi myekundu. Kama *Ormocarpum* wengine, maganda yake yana viungo, na hukatika kuwa vipande vyenye mbegu moja moja ambavyo mara nyingi vina vinundu au vinywele vigumu. Maelezo ya Pakia kuhusu jina yanaelekeza kwenye mashina, ambayo hujisokota na kujipinda.
about.dg: *Humbo ra nguluwe* ni chitsaka cha jamii ya kunde, na wakati wanjina ni muhi mdide. Makodzage ganaganywa kukala makodza madide manji ga mviringo kanda-kanda ya mongo wa kodza. Maruwage ni ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde, mara nyinji genye mistari ya kundu. Dza *Ormocarpum* zanjina, makakaya gana mafundo, na ganavundzika kukala vipande vya tembe mwenga mwenga, ambavyo mara nyinji vina vifundo au nyere ngumu. Pakia anagomba kukala dzina hiri rinaonyesa mihiye, ambayo inabeta na kudzizunguluka.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal bushland and thicket and in forest margins.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vikavu vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Chinamera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu ya pwani, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

culture.en: Pakia gives this as an example of a Digo plant name built like a phrase with a linking word: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'stomach of pig'. In Mgombato, *nguluwe* is the bush pig and *mahumbo* means innards, stomach and intestines. Pakia records that the same name is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili.
culture.sw: Pakia analitoa hili kama mfano wa jina la mmea wa Kidigo lililoundwa kama kirai chenye neno la kuunganisha: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'tumbo la nguruwe'. Katika Mgombato, *nguluwe* ni nguruwe-mwitu na *mahumbo* maana yake matumbo, yaani tumbo na utumbo. Pakia anarekodi kwamba jina hilohilo linashirikiwa na Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganayodzengbwa dza maneno manji ganayoungwa ni neno dza *ra*: *humbo ra nguluwe*. Kpwenye Mgombato, *nguluwe* ni nguluwe wa weruni (*bush pig*), na *mahumbo* ni vitu vya ndani ya mwiri wa nyama, dza ndani na mahumbo ganjina. Pakia anaandika kukala Aduruma, Agiryama na Aswahili piya anachiiha vivyo.

names.en: Digo: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'stomach of the pig'. Pakia's Appendix III also lists *mpingwa* for this species, but the same name is given there to the sicklebush *Dichrostachys cinerea* (*mchinjiri*). No English name is recorded. Pakia writes the genus as '*Ormocapum*'; the correct spelling is *Ormocarpum*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'tumbo la nguruwe'. Kiambatisho III cha Pakia pia kinaorodhesha *mpingwa* kwa spishi hii, lakini jina hilohilo limetolewa humo kwa mpangwa (*Dichrostachys cinerea*, *mchinjiri*). Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa. Pakia anaandika jenasi kama '*Ormocapum*'; tahajia sahihi ni *Ormocarpum*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *humbo ra nguluwe*, 'humbo (ndani) ra nguluwe'. Kpwenye *Appendix III* ya Pakia, aina ihi piya inaihwa *mpingwa*, ela phapho phapho dzina hiro rinahewa *mchinjiri* (*Dichrostachys cinerea*). Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa. Pakia anaandika jenasi kukala '*Ormocapum*'; maandiko ga kpweli ni *Ormocarpum*.
